The Petitioner has filed this Writ Petition seeking issuance of a Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus calling for the records pertaining to the impugned order made in R.No.1514/FSD/2022, dated 30.08.2022 passed by the third respondent and to quash the same and consequently to direct the respondents to remove the lock and seal of the Petitioner's Petty Shop and permit the petitioner to carry on the business in the same premises.
2.Heard the learned counsel appearing on either side and perused the materials placed before this Court.

3.This Court, in the above Writ Petition, by order, dated 16.11.2022, passed the following Order:
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
The petitioner is running a petty shop in the name and style of 'Sastha Maligai Shop' situated at Ismailpuram, 6th Street, Munichalai Road, Madurai for the past 25 years.

The fifth respondent police registered a case against the petitioner alleging that on a raid on 25.08.2022, it was found that the petitioner was having 34 pockets of prohibited Ganesh Tobacco in his shop.

Hence,
he was arrested and a case was registered against him in Crime No.435 of 2022 for the offence under Section 24(1) of Cigarette and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 and he was also directed to pay fine.

sentences.text: Under the said circumstances, the third respondent herein has issued the order impugned dated 30.08.2022 made in R.No. 1514/FSD/2022 under Section 34(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 and on the same day, the petitioner's shop was locked and sealed.
Hence, the petitioner is before this Court.
2.The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has not committed any offence as alleged by the prosecution.

, the petitioner is directed to pay a sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) on or before 29.11.2022 to the credit of the District Siddha Medical Officer CCRI PKM [A/c.No.10767823177, IFSC Code:-SBIN0000898, State Bank of India, Periyakulam Branch].
He is also directed not to sell any banned food and Gutka's & Tobacco items in future.
He is further directed to fix a board in his shop stating that as per the undertaking and the order of the Madurai Bench of Madras High Court, there will be no sale of Tobacco items here.

sentences.text: 5.Post the matter on 29.11.2022 for filing compliance affidavit.

4.In compliance of the above said order, the Petitioner deposits a sum of Rs.25,000/- as ordered above and also placed a flex infront of the shop stating that ''there will be no sale of tobacco items''.
5.In view of the above circumstances,the respondents are directed to remove the lock and seal of the Petitioner's shop within a period of two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

It is made clear that if the Petitioner again indulge in the such kind of business once again, the r e s p o n d e n t s a r e d i r e c t e d t o c l o s e t h e P e t i t i o n e r ' s s h o p p e r m a n e n t l y https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis and cancel the licence granted to the Petitioner's shop.
6.With the above direction and observation, the Writ Petition stands disposed of.
No costs.
Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petitions are closed.
